_how_to_use: Your real projects and experiences: the ONLY material essays may draw from. Write facts plainly, with real numbers. 'my_words' are phrases you'd actually say; they keep essays sounding like you. Only status 'confirmed' stories are used. 'keywords' are words that identify the story, so the linter can stop the same story appearing twice in one application and block unconfirmed ones.

stories.title: Internship: document search tool
facts: Built a tool that turns a team's PDFs and slide decks into searchable text for an internal chatbot
Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, a vector database
Wrote a 40-question benchmark; the tool answered 30 correctly vs 18 for the old keyword search
stories.hardest_part: Cleaning the source documents before any AI work: half of them were scanned images.
my_words: most of the quality came from cleaning the documents, not the model
stories.lesson: Retrieval quality is mostly data quality.

stories.title: Student club event app
facts: Led a team of 4 building a React Native app for club events with RSVPs and reminders
Grew to 300 weekly users across 6 clubs in one semester
my_words: I kept asking people what made them skip events
